_comment: Reveal flavor lines keyed by (class, outcome). Story 7.6 — data-driven (MOD-2), ≥3 variants per key, no-repeat-in-a-row handled by the sequencer. Outcomes: returned / wounded / dead. Fallback covers any class/outcome without an entry.

returned: Came back grinning, sword notched and story ready.
Walked in like they never doubted it. Maybe they didn't.
Dust and blood — but that's a fighter's kind of clean.
wounded: Favouring one arm, and waving off the fuss anyway.
Took a beating and gave a worse one — still, they're limping.
Won the fight, lost some skin. Sore for a while.
dead: They stood their ground. That's where they stayed.
The last thing they did was hold the line.
A fighter's death — facing it, not fleeing it.

returned: Slipped back in without a sound, pockets heavier.
No one saw them leave, no one saw them return. Typical.
Grinning at a secret they won't share.
wounded: A rare misstep — and a rarer wound to show for it.
Quick, but not quite quick enough this time.
Cut where the shadows didn't quite reach.
dead: Even the quick run out of corners eventually.
No clever way out of this one.
They vanished for good this time.

returned: Returned murmuring about something read in the ruins.
Robes singed, eyes bright with what they'd learned.
Home already, sketching a rune only they understand.
wounded: Magic has a price. This time it was paid in blood.
A spell went wrong — or a foe went right.
Drained and burned, but still muttering incantations.
dead: Their last spell wasn't enough. Few ever are.
The runes went quiet with them.
Knowledge died with them in the dark.

returned: Back from the wilds with mud, meat, and good news.
Read the land like a page and came home wiser.
The forest let this one leave. Not all are so lucky.
wounded: Something out there was faster than the arrow.
Limped in on a trail of their own blood.
The wilds bit back this time.
dead: The wild kept them. It usually does, in the end.
No trail led back for this one.
They became part of the country they loved.

returned: Returned with a blessing and a weary smile.
Faith held where the road did not.
Home whole, crediting something larger than themselves.
wounded: Even the faithful bleed. They tended others first.
Hurt, but still asking after everyone else.
Their prayers guarded the party, not quite themselves.
dead: They gave their last blessing freely.
Faith walked them all the way to the end.
Gone to whatever they believed was waiting.

returned: Returned with steady hands and everyone's thanks.
Mended the party and made it home besides.
Home, quietly proud of who they kept alive.
wounded: Spent themselves keeping others whole.
Healed everyone but themselves, it seems.
Hurt in the saving of someone else.
dead: They saved the others. Not themselves.
The healer's last act was for someone else.
Gone — and the party lives because of it.

returned: Home, and richer for the road.
Back at the hearth, none the worse.
The road was kind this time.
wounded: Bloodied, but breathing.
They'll mend, given time and beer.
Home, and hurting — but home.
dead: They didn't come back.
The chair sits empty tonight.
One less name at the table.
